QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_42

question.text: Under SEBI's Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for AIFs (w.e.f. August 31, 2025), the categorisation into Mid-size Regulated Entity applies when the sum of corpus of all AIFs/VCFs managed by a Manager is:

answer.text: More than INR 3,000 crore and less than INR 10,000 crore

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI CSCRF Circular April 30, 2025: Mid-size RE corpus = > INR 3,000 crore and < INR 10,000 crore. Small-size: INR 3,000 crore or below → self-certification. Qualified RE = INR 10,000 crore and above. Categorisation is at MANAGER level (not per fund). The Trap: Each alternative range is either wrong band or fabricated. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests CSCRF categorisation. Manager's Pro-Tip: If your total manager-level corpus is hovering near INR 3,000 cr or INR 10,000 cr, model CSCRF-compliance cost BEFORE the financial-year-end data crystallises. Jumping a category mid-year is not allowed — you get one year to ramp capability.
